Variations

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The 'fine' quality material can replace a normal drop with a base rate of 1/100. This can be increased by using items with the fine material finding attribute.

Variations

Requirement

  • At least Hunting lvl. 40.

Attributes (Input)

This item provides these attributes when used as an input for some activities. Fine materials used also benifit from a global bonus when used as inputs.

Quality Attributes

+40% Work efficiency While doing Hunting.

+40% Work efficiency While doing Hunting.
Global +40% Work efficiency
Global +200% Fine material finding
Global +10% Double rewards
Global +100% Bonus experience

Uses

Activity Input

Tarsilium arrows can be used as an input for the following activities:

Activity Name Locations Requirements Note
Alligator hunting Bog Top in GDTE Needs 1x Hunting level 30 Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.
Bear hunting Nomad Woods in Jarvonia Needs 1x Hunting level 20 Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.
Deer hunting Mangrove Forest in GDTE Needs 1x Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.
Ectoplasm slime hunting Wraithwater in Empire of Wallisia Needs 1x Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.
Lizard hunting Old Arena Ruins in GDTE Needs 1x Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.
Squirrel hunting Nomad Woods in Jarvonia Needs 1x Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.
Unicorn hunting Stalking Yew Woods in Empire of Wallisia Needs 1x Hunting level 30 Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.
Wolf hunting Sanguine Hills in Jarvonia Needs 1x Arrows This activity gains extra benefits from using fine material inputs.

Primary Recipe Output

Fletch tarsilium arrows

You shape the dark tarsilium into arrowheads, their inky blackness promising a silent and swift demise. The feathers, a stark contrast to the metal, are carefully attached, completing these deadly weapons.

Craft ominous projectiles tipped with dark tarsilium.
